Foreword 
The Government of the Republic of Zambia is committed to taking health services as 
close to the family as possible and work towards the attainment of the Universal health 
coverage by 2030. 
It is with the above in mind that the Government embarked on the implementation of the 
provisions of the constitution of Zambia Amendment Act No.2 of 2016. 
To facilitate that, the Government Developed the National Decentralization Policy of 
2023. The policy provides for the devolution of District Health Services (Primary Heath 
Care Services) and Ambulance services to the Local Authorities. 
As a sector the Ministry developed the health sector devolution implementation plan 
which is to guide the devolution process for the health sector. District Health Services 
have been defined in the sector plan as "essential health care based on practical, 
scientifically sound, socially acceptable methods and technology made universally 
accessible to individuals and families in the community through their full participation and 
at a cost that the community and country can afford to maintain at every stage of their 
development in the spirit of self-reliance and self-determination; The services that are to 
be devolved are the primary health care services so that they serve as a vehicle to the 
attainment of Universal health Coverage by 2030. 
The Standard Operating Procedures have been prepared as an additional tool to facilitate 
the smooth implementation of the devolved District Health Service functions to the Local 
Authorities. 
Stakeholders are encouraged to make use of the SOPs. 
ristopher Simoonga 
Per 
nent Secretary-Administration 
MINISTRY OF HEATH

STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES FOR THE DEVOLVED DISTRICT ARCHIVES FUNCTION UNDER THE NATIONAL ARCHIVES  
 
FOREWORD 
In accordance with the Constitution of Zambia (Amendment) Act No. 2 of 2016, 
the National Decentralisation Policy of 2023, and Cabinet Office Circular No. 2 
of 2023, the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security has successfully 
devolved 
the 
District 
Archives 
function 
to 
Local 
Authorities. 
This 
Decentralisation initiative aims to enhance service delivery by bringing essential 
services closer to the people. 
The devolution of the District Archives function involves the establishment of 
local archives to survey, appraise, and store closed personnel, procurement, 
financial, and patient records. Effective records management ensures proper 
creation, organization, storage, and disposal of these records to meet legal, 
operational, and historical needs. By decentralizing this function, the Ministry 
seeks to improve service delivery and accessibility for citizens. 
I am, therefore, elated at the successful development of these Standard 
Operating Procedures to guide Local Authorities in the effective management and 
operation of the devolved District Archives function. These SOPs will ensure that 
local authorities can efficiently handle the responsibilities associated with this 
important task.  
 
The Ministry is highly indebted to all those who contributed to the successful 
development of these Standard Operating Procedures.  
         
 
 
 
 
 
Dickson Matembo (Mr.) 
PERMANENT SECRETARY-CRIAR
